import React from 'react'; import './Education.css'; const Education = () => { const education = [ { degree: "Master of Science in Computer Science", institution: "Massachusetts Institute of Technology", period: "2017 - 2019", location: "Cambridge, MA", gpa: "3.9/4.0", relevant: [ "Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence", "Advanced Algorithms and Data Structures", "Software Engineering Principles", "Database Systems and Architecture" ], thesis: "Deep Learning Approaches for Natural Language Understanding", honors: ["Magna Cum Laude", "Research Excellence Award"] }, { degree: "Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering", institution: "University of California, Berkeley", period: "2013 - 2017", location: "Berkeley, CA", gpa: "3.8/4.0", relevant: [ "Computer Systems and Architecture", "Software Development and Programming", "Mathematics and Statistics", "Electrical Engineering Fundamentals" ], thesis: "Optimizing Embedded Systems for IoT Applications", honors: ["Summa Cum Laude", "Dean's List (8 semesters)", "Outstanding Senior Project"] } ]; const certifications = [ { name: "AWS Certified Solutions Architect", issuer: "Amazon Web Services", date: "2023", credentialId: "AWS-SA-2023-001" }, { name: "Google Cloud Professional Developer", issuer: "Google Cloud", date: "2022", credentialId: "GCP-PD-2022-456" }, { name: "Certified Kubernetes Administrator", issuer: "Cloud Native Computing Foundation", date: "2022", credentialId: "CKA-2022-789" }, { name: "MongoDB Certified Developer", issuer: "MongoDB University", date: "2021", credentialId: "MDB-DEV-2021-123" } ]; return (

Education & Certifications

Academic Background

{education.map((edu, index) => (

{edu.degree}

{edu.institution}

{edu.period} {edu.location} GPA: {edu.gpa}
Relevant Coursework:
    {edu.relevant.map((course, idx) => (
  • {course}
    • ))}
Thesis:

{edu.thesis}

Honors & Awards:
{edu.honors.map((honor, idx) => ( {honor} ))}
))}

Professional Certifications

{certifications.map((cert, index) => (
🏆

{cert.name}

{cert.issuer}

{cert.date} ID: {cert.credentialId}
))}
); }; export default Education;
